# ui::DragResponse

Header: `winui/ui/DragDrop.hpp`.

A drop target's answer to a drag over it: what a drop there would do, and what the pointer shows meanwhile.

Returned by [Element::drag_over()](element.md#drag_over) and the handler set with [Element::on_drag_over()](element.md#on_drag_over), which are asked when the drag comes over the element and at every move after. A refusal (`operation` None, the default) passes the question on to the next drop target up the tree. The first one that accepts gets the drop.

Example: 
```cpp
auto zone = std::make_unique<ui::BorderControl>();
zone->set_allow_drop(true);
zone->on_drag_over([](const ui::DragEventArgs& e)
{
    if (e.data.files.empty())
    {
        return ui::DragResponse{};
    }
    return ui::DragResponse{.operation = ui::DataPackageOperation::Copy, .caption = "Attach"};
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `operation` | `DataPackageOperation` | `DataPackageOperation::None` | What a drop here would do; None refuses it. |
| `caption` | `std::string` |  | [Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) shown in a small box beside the pointer; empty shows none. |
| `glyph_visible` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the operation glyph is shown beside the pointer. |
